exercises.name: Chest press
exercises.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are around chest height. Choose a comfortable weight.
exercises.cue: Keep your back supported. Press smoothly, then return with control.
exercises.mistake: Avoid shrugging your shoulders or locking your elbows forcefully.

exercises.name: Seated row
exercises.setup: Adjust the seat and support so you can reach the handles comfortably.
exercises.cue: Keep your torso steady and pull your elbows back with control.
exercises.mistake: Avoid swinging your torso to move the weight.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.setup: Follow the machine setup instructions; align the pivot with your knee and position the pad above your ankle.
exercises.cue: Extend smoothly through a comfortable range and lower with control.
exercises.mistake: Avoid throwing the weight or forcing an uncomfortable range.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.setup: Use a stable bench and a light, comfortable pair of dumbbells. Ask gym staff for help with unfamiliar setup.
exercises.cue: Press smoothly and keep your wrists aligned over your forearms.
exercises.mistake: Avoid dropping the weights quickly or forcing a deep range.
